# Apache HTTPD (AJP) — root-context-push-url-sse

AJP root-context-sse with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push. The relocated endpoint needs no separate ws:// block, because the AJP worker carries the push stream itself.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# AJP with the PUSH endpoint relocated to /VAADIN/push.
#
# Compare with ajp/root-context-push-url, where the relocated endpoint needs a
# separate <Location> pointing at ws://vaadin:8080 because WebSocket cannot ride
# AJP. Over SSE the AJP worker carries the push stream like any other request,
# so the relocation needs no proxy rule at all.
ProxyPass         "/"      ajp://vaadin:8009/ flushpackets=on
ProxyPassReverse  "/"      ajp://vaadin:8009/
```
